description: This file implements the internal server-side logic for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, and cryptographic operations, within the Rialto media framework. It defines classes and functions for session management, key handling, and interaction with the main thread and OCdm system.

classes.name: MediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the internal server logic for managing media key sessions, including creation, deletion, and cryptographic operations, within the Rialto media framework.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to the IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeys
methods.description: Creates media keys for a given key system (not used in server context).

methods.name: createMediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a MediaKeysServerInternal instance for a specific key system.

methods.name: MediaKeysServerInternal constructor
methods.description: Initializes the MediaKeysServerInternal object, setting up main thread, OCdm system, and session factory.

methods.name: MediaKeysServerInternal destructor
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters client from main thread.
